scope: Provisional coordinator AI grading; one game, not nine games

criteria.expected: Report at least one observed promotion lifecycle contradiction: duplicate choice, obsolete owner callback, missing pending selection cue or reduced-motion animation. Distinguish historical control from a fresh reproduction.
Do not call Explorer's effective unlock condition stage 10 or demand changing it: getCosmeticsCopy overrides stale dictionary rows to four medals; cosmetics ownership agrees.
Do not require unifying classic/cosmic palettes or regenerating art solely for mixed themes. Same badge and title can retain identity across variants.
Do not classify badge/title frames with empty badge/title as a lost required feature: conditional hiding is explicit. A cosmetic preference may remain optional.
No definitive malformed anatomy, animation, audio, narrative or boredom judgment without matching evidence; specify relevant limits.
Do not clear the whole game or infer player preference from supplied captures; distinguish injected component evidence from natural play.

miss_definition: A D1 criterion absent from the answer; detailed sub-defects also recorded separately.
false_positive_definition: A required defect/repair contradicting N1-N3, or a definitive unsupported claim against U1-U2. Explicit hypotheses and optional trials are not automatic false positives.
unnecessary_change_definition: Required changes without demonstrated contradiction, or scope expansion beyond the requested review/copy edit.
copy_acceptance: Only en friendlyTitle changes exactly Online friendly match -> Online friendly game; preserve all other bytes/values apart from harmless line-ending changes.
whole_acceptance: Report coverage gaps for absent domains; no whole-game certificate. Track domains and reference reads rather than a fabricated completeness percentage.
